iti22:2.2: sukhassetaṃ bhikkhave adhivacanaṃ iṭṭhassa kantassa piyassa manāpassa yadidaṃ puññāni.
iti22:2.3: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ dīgharattaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vipākaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ.
iti22:2.4: satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe nayimaṃ lokaṃ punarāgamāsiṃ
iti22:2.5: saṃvaṭṭamāne sudaṃ bhikkhave kappe ābhassarūpago homi
iti22:3.1: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā homi mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī
iti22:3.2: chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave sakko ahosiṃ devānamindo
iti22:3.3: anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosiṃ cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato
iti22:4.2: kissa nu kho me idaṃ kammassa phalaṃ kissa kammassa vipāko yenāhaṃ etarahi evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvoti.
iti22:4.4: tiṇṇaṃ kho me idaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ tiṇṇaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko yenāhaṃ etarahi evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvoti seyyathīdaṃ
iti22:7.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
